summary: Completed testing of FamFocus Hub Family Management feature - Family Switching UI and Family Invite System. All 16 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI fully functional with Create Family modal, Invite modal, and Switch Family functionality working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Family Management page loads correctly at /family route
GET /api/families returns user's families with correct structure (family_id, name, role, member_count, is_current)
POST /api/families creates new family and adds creator as admin
POST /api/families/{family_id}/invite sends invitation with email and role
GET /api/families/invites/pending returns pending invites for current user's email
POST /api/families/invites/{invite_id}/accept creates membership and updates invite status
POST /api/families/invites/{invite_id}/decline updates invite status to declined
DELETE /api/families/{family_id}/leave removes membership (cannot leave own family as parent)
All endpoints properly require authentication (return 401 without session)
Create Family modal has data-testid attributes for testing
Invite modal has role selector (Member/Parent) and email input
Switch button shows success toast and updates Current badge
Family cards show role (Parent/Admin), member count, and appropriate action buttons

context_for_next_testing_agent: Family Management feature fully tested. Uses cookie-based authentication (session_token cookie). Family endpoints: GET/POST /api/families, POST /api/families/{id}/invite, GET /api/families/invites/pending, POST /api/families/invites/{id}/accept|decline, POST /api/families/switch/{id}, DELETE /api/families/{id}/leave. Parent's own family uses user_id as family_id.

Shows 'Family Management' title with 'Switch between families or create new ones' subtitle
